reader_summary.overview: One of the recurring themes we talk about a lot on the a16z Podcast is how software changes organizations, and vice versa... More broadly: it’s really about how companies of all kinds innovate with the org structures and tools that they have. But we've come a long way from the question of " does IT matter " to answering the question of what org structures, processes, architectures.
